name: Can I get a quote before booking?

text: Yes, simply submit an enquiry and our team will provide a tailored quote, typically within 1 hour.

name: How much does it cost to hire a room?

text: We offer a range of packages and always aim to be reasonable with our pricing, working flexibly to find an option that suits your event and budget.

name: Is there a minimum booking size or spend?

text: Minimum requirements can vary depending on the space and date. Contact us to discuss your specific needs.

name: Is catering included with venue hire?

text: We offer a range of catering packages which can be included as part of your booking.
Yes, we can cater for a wide range of dietary needs, including vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and allergies.
There are several public car parks within walking distance of the venue.

name: Is the venue in the congestion charge zone?

text: Yes, the venue is within central London’s congestion charge zone. We recommend using public transport where possible.
Yes, the venue is fully accessible. Please let us know any specific requirements when booking.

name: What time can I access the room for setup?

text: We can be flexible depending on your requirements and your agreed arrival time, and will confirm access details in advance of your event.
Your booking includes room hire, AV equipment, Wi-Fi, and on-site support. Catering can also be added.

name: Will there be support on the day?

text: Yes, our on-site team will be available throughout your event to ensure everything runs smoothly.

name: Will there be a dedicated event manager on the day?

text: Yes, you will be allocated a dedicated event manager who will oversee everything on the day, meet you on arrival, and manage the event from start to finish.

Our cancellation and rescheduling terms are tiered depending on how far in advance notice is given, unless a specific arrangement has been agreed with the client. Our team will provide full details at the time of enquiry.

name: Can I book a meeting room at short notice?

text: Yes but it all depends on our availability, but we do our best to accommodate short-notice and last-minute bookings wherever possible.

name: Do you have more than one venue?

text: Yes, we also have a venue in Moorgate, located at 1-3 Bonhill Street. Right on the edge of the City, with Shoreditch on the doorstep, this venue is perfectly placed for delegates travelling from across London and beyond, with several major transport links including Liverpool Street Station, Moorgate Station and Old Street Station all within easy reach.
